notes: All currency figures are in full EUR, scaled from EUR millions. netIncome means the consolidated profit attributable to Bayer AG stockholders (the report distinguishes income after taxes including non-controlling interests). totalEquity is the directly published parent-attributable equity, with no subtraction performed.

revenue and operatingIncome follow the continuing-operations scope published in each selected annual report. netIncome includes continuing and discontinued operations. Material divestments include Covestro, Animal Health and Currenta; the historical series has scope breaks. The five-year 2020 summary uses its restated FY2019 and last-reported FY2016–2018 history; the 2025 summary is used for FY2021–2025. FY2015 sales/EBIT/employees are the subsequently adjusted figures in the 2018 summary.

operatingCashFlow is cash provided by operating activities including the separately published discontinued-operations contributions where applicable; gross cash flow/free cash flow are not substitutes. capex is actual cash outflows for property, plant, equipment and intangible assets, normalized negative; newly capitalized additions in the segment table are not substituted for cash purchases.

totalDebt is Financial liabilities from the old published five-year summary for FY2007–2010. Later years are null where only separate maturity components or net debt were extracted; no net-debt substitution or summation was made. Financial-liability maturity tables include future interest and were not used as debt balances.

dilutedEPS uses directly reported diluted figures or explicit report statements that diluted equals basic; FY2007–2008 and FY2011 remain null rather than assuming basic equals diluted. Historic per-share figures retain the split/rights-issue bases published in their source; they are not manually adjusted.

sharesOutstanding is the published number of shares entitled to dividend at year end, rounded by the issuer to 0.01 million shares. employees is year-end full-time equivalent employees. FY2011 balance sheet is the restated opening 1 Jan 2012 balance published in the 2013 report.
